prompt_record.text: Edit this no-results illustration. Change only the arrangement: the two empty frames must NOT overlap or touch. Place the smaller second frame to the right and slightly above the first, with a visible transparent gap of about 6 percent of the whole canvas width between their nearest outer edges. Keep both complete, generously inside the canvas. Keep the small cyan magnifying glass on the first frame, the ivory paper, graphite edge linework, refined hand-drawn shading and all other style characteristics. Do not add objects. Landscape3:2. Preserve genuine transparent alpha; absolutely no visible glow, aura, shadows floating beyond edges, background or text. Clear, calm empty-search-result metaphor at384x256.

art_review.notes: The two empty frames are now separate; the small cyan magnifier keeps the search metaphor clear. Explicit fit-with-padding improves the outer margins.
observations: The native layout had narrow side margins. The selected rendition uniformly fits the complete native canvas into a nominal 90% area and centres it on transparent padding.
At 384x256 the exact 3:2 fit is 345x230, with 19px left/20px right and 13px top/bottom canvas padding; one-pixel asymmetry is integer centring.

The nearest alpha>=128 gap is approximately 6px in the unpadded 384x256 rendition; the fit does not increase that gap and the requested approximately 6% gap is not met. The narrower gap was accepted for candidate exploration because the frames are clearly separate.
No fake background, lettering, warning cue, arrow, progress signal, face or mascot observed.

alpha_caveats: Source alpha ranges 0–254; no fully opaque source pixels.
Very faint nonzero alpha may reach canvas edges. Significant-alpha boxes are reported separately; alpha dust was not cleaned.
Lanczos resampling changes per-pixel alpha and may reach 255 through ringing. No alpha normalization was performed.
